summary: This video showcases a budget Frost team setup for the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque in Dragonheir. The lineup features Aethereal, Hvitar, Olgan, Lossenia, and Feenja, demonstrating top-tier damage output even at low or zero Inspiration levels. At Inspiration 0, this setup achieved 845M+ damage, outperforming Dauntless and several other team comps, while hitting over 1.2B with optimal gear. Detailed instructions are provided for gearing, stat priority, pet selection (Lava Batwing), and tuning a strict 15-second skill rotation.

heroes.name: Aethereal
heroes.note: Built with stacked Attack and Enlightenment using the Gory Injector artifact to maximize derivative cold damage.

heroes.name: Hvitar
heroes.note: Built with Attack and Accuracy to share stats and trigger derivative damage buffs for the team.

heroes.name: Olgan
heroes.note: Grants Frost allies +25% Attack Up; requires Accuracy and extra HP/Defense stats if struggling with survivability.

heroes.name: Lossenia
heroes.note: Equipped with Mystic Conch and built with maximum Accuracy to share with teammates, reducing their stat requirements.

heroes.name: Feenja
heroes.note: Provides Resistance Up II and shares Resistance with adjacent allies, built with Skill Haste to maintain team rotation.

teams.note: Budget Frost composition tuned for a 15-second skill rotation using Lava Batwing pet and Skill Haste runes.

meta_changes: Budget Frost team utilizing Epic hero Olgan outdamages Dauntless and other premium comps at low Inspiration on Mekkatorque.
tips: Aim for a strict 15-second skill recast rotation by equipping Skill Haste runes and tuning skill timings.
Stack maximum Accuracy on Lossenia to share stats via Bone Resonance, lowering Accuracy requirements for other heroes.
If Olgan dies early due to low Inspiration levels, replace some of his Attack gear with HP and Defense to keep him alive.
title: Best Frost Team vs Mekkatorque | Rasp of Gears S8 | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
